description: This Java class defines a Fragment for Android that manages scene transitions with custom animations, handling user interactions to switch scenes and maintaining state across configuration changes.

classes.name: CustomTransitionFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages scene transitions with custom animations.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes scenes, sets up click listener, restores state, and shows initial scene.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current scene index to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events to transition to the next scene with a custom transition.
